title: Ang Pirma
setup: Tumawag si Tita Baby. 'Anak, may papel lang… pirma lang. Alam mo namang tumulong ako sa'yo noon.'
setup_en: Tita Baby calls. 'Anak, it's just a paper… just a signature. You know I helped you back then.'

success.text: Nalinawan. Nawala ang utang. Tumaas ang samahan.
success.text_en: It clears. The debt is gone. Bonds grow.

fail.text: Nasalanta ang koneksyon. Nanatili ang utang.
fail.text_en: Ties are damaged. The debt stays.

choices.label: Hihingi ako ng tulong kay Nurse Lea.
choices.label_en: I'll ask Nurse Lea for help.

success.text: Tumulong si Nurse Lea. Nawala ang utang.
success.text_en: Nurse Lea helps. The debt clears.

fail.text_en: Not yet, but someone stands with you.

callback: Debt cleared -> Ch4 with lighter burden.
